    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineValidity" name="Determine validity and refund justification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRefund" name="Send refund to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Case resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Completed" name="Complaint process completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineValidity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_DetermineValidity" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="SendTask_SendRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint-handling">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Complaint" name="Complaint filed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Decision" name="Decision notification"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_ComplaintFiled"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DecisionNotified" name="Decision notification" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DecisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RefundSent" name="Refund" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRefund" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerInitiates" name="Customer has a complaint">
      <bpmn:outgoing>CFlow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>CFlow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CFlow_2</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_DecisionReceived" name="Decision notification received">
      <bpmn:incoming>CFlow_2</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DecisionReceived" messageRef="Msg_Decision"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide feedback on satisfaction">

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_1" sourceRef="Start_CustomerInitiates" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DecisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_3" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_DecisionReceived" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolutionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>IntermediateCatch_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineValidity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_NotifyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ComplaintFiled" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineValidity" name="Determine validity and refund justification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRefund" name="Send refund to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Case resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Completed" name="Complaint process completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineValidity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_DetermineValidity" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="SendTask_SendRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Feedback" targetRef="End_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when an external party sends a message or reports a case, so the opening is a message occurrence that starts the case: Model the process opening as a plain start event (bpmn:startEvent) with no incoming sequence flow, and place a bpmn:messageEventDefinition child inside it to express the message. Never write a message start as its own element type directly under the process or subProcess (for example a messageStartEvent element), because BPMN 2.0.2 allows only flow element types such as startEvent in that position.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when an external party sends a message or reports a case, so the opening is a message occurrence that starts the case

rules.instruction: Give every process and every expanded subProcess its own explicit start event and end event. A trigger that occurs after the main flow (for example later feedback or a return) is joined to the main flow by a gateway, or modeled as an event subprocess or a separate process.
rules.situation: the description states that the process begins when an external party, such as a customer, initiates the case by filing or sending something, and the first internal step only follows that trigger

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action (an activity it names), rather than when an external message, signal, time or condition occurs: Model a start event for the process beginning, with no incoming flow, followed by a task labeled with that participant's action in the description's own wording. Do not label the start event with the action, and do not replace the action with the start event.
rules.situation: The description says the process begins when an external party performs an action that is itself a work step the party takes (for example filing or reporting something), and the process then depends on that action.

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant outside the company performs an action, such as choosing or supplying information, and the process then depends on that action: Model a task for the participant's own action, labeled with the verb and object the description uses for what the participant does (for example, 'provide ...' or 'select ...'). Do not label the task with the organization's receipt or processing of that input, and do not merge a separately described participant action into a task for the organization's follow-up communication.
rules.situation: the description states that an external party performs an action on its own, and the process neither sends a message for that action nor waits for a message about it

rules.instruction: When the description says a party performs a named action (for example filing, submitting or giving something) and does not say that a message is sent to or awaited from another party: Model that action as a plain task labeled with the description's own wording for the action. Do not model it as a send task or an intermediate message catch event. Use a send task or a message catch event only when the description states a message being sent or awaited.
rules.situation: the description says a party performs a named action (for example filing, submitting or giving something) and does not say that a message is sent to or awaited from another party
